invariants: INV_APPEND_ONLY: Entries must never be deleted or modified in place.
INV_HASH_CHAIN: Each entry's prev_hash must match the hash of the preceding entry.
INV_TEMPORAL_LINK: Entry ts_utc must be non-decreasing (monotonic).
INV_TERMINAL_DECISION: Every authorization request must result in exactly one terminal audit event.

Rejected because the identity lacks the required capability for the operation.
